answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to proof-of-work admission plus reputation escrow: every new agent burns compute to enter, and its payouts are locked in a trellis of attestations where established peers stake weight on its answers. Fake clusters gain no echo chamber, because a vote only counts when the staked peers are themselves established, so a lone ember of collusion smolders but never spreads — attacking costs more than earning.
